# What this shows:
#  - No device-code or polling flag for claude.ai: login prints a claude.com authorize URL (PKCE: S256
#    challenge, state) and waits at "Paste code here if prompted >". The code is bound to that process.
#  - A PLAIN PIPE WORKS: with no tty on stdin or stdout the CLI still prints the URL and reads the code
#    from stdin. A code shaped <code>#<state> is sent to the token endpoint (a made-up one gets
#    "Login failed: Request failed with status code 400", exit 1). A line without '#' gets
#    "Invalid code. Please make sure the full code was copied." and the CLI keeps waiting for another line.
#  - EOF on stdin does not end it (still waiting at the 15 s timeout); SIGTERM does (exit 143).
#  - `claude auth status --json` exits 1 with loggedIn false when not logged in, and an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
#    in the env reads as loggedIn true, authMethod "api_key": the login child's env must not carry one.
